column1: # Tag audit proposals — removal round 1, plus two additions from the rewritten
# ribbon rule. Every row is a decision the owner already made in review; the file
# records them the same way as any batch. See #174.
# HOW TO REVIEW: delete the rows you disagree with. What survives is applied.
# Nothing else to fill in; the deletions are themselves the record of your call.
# Then say so, and the agent runs scripts/apply-tag-audit.mjs, the validators and
# the Playwright suite. Do not edit proposals.original.tsv — the difference
# between it and this file is how your rejections get remembered.
# Read the name; the code beside it is what the script applies to, and a row whose
# name and code disagree is refused. To see a flag: https://flagfilter.com/?q=<name>
# Columns: name, code, tag or alias, add|remove|alias, confidence, why.

column6: The five figures on the canoe are X-shaped, stylised people; they do not read as stars.
The only brown is the cliffs inside the shield, which is detail under the colour rule.
There is no star on the flag; the emblem is a triskelion.
The field is cut by a cross, not into horizontal stripes.
The field is cut by a cross, not into vertical stripes.
The name sits on a scroll with curled ends.
The motto runs on a white band arching across the globe.
A blue bow ties the laurel wreath, and the motto sits on a small scroll inside the arms.
